vo: One person. Twenty-person output. No team. Here's the whole system in forty-five seconds.
Step zero: sell a painkiller, not a vitamin. Find a problem people already pay to fix.
Rung one, the inbox Bot. It learns your rules, drafts every reply in your voice, and gives you your mornings back.
Rung two, delivery. The moment someone pays, onboarding runs itself.
Rung three, marketing. Every morning, ten new leads land in your inbox.
Rung four, sales. A voice Bot calls every lead first, and coaches you for the rest.
Then connect them all to one shared brain, so every Bot learns from every other.
The Bots do the work. You bring the vision. One person, and a whole lot of agents.
